edition.en: Standard Ebooks edition of O. Henry’s short fiction
edition.zh: 据 Standard Ebooks 欧·亨利短篇小说集

basis.en: First published in December 1905; the author died in 1910.
basis.zh: 1905 年 12 月首次发表；作者卒于 1910 年。

note.en: O. Henry’s Christmas story, first printed in a New York newspaper in 1905 and collected in The Four Million (1906). A young couple with one dollar and eighty-seven cents between them each sell the one treasure they own to buy a gift for the other’s. The narrator calls them foolish and then, in the last paragraph, the wisest of all, and the story earns the reversal.
note.zh: 欧·亨利的圣诞故事，1905 年首次刊于纽约一家报纸，后收入《四百万》（1906）。一对年轻夫妻手头只有一块八毛七，各自卖掉了自己唯一的珍宝，为对方的珍宝买一份礼物。叙述者先说他们傻，最后一段又说他们是最聪明的人——这个反转，故事挣得起。

excerpt.orig: Of all who give and receive gifts, such as they are wisest. Everywhere they are wisest. They are the magi.
excerpt.en: Of all who give and receive gifts, such as they are wisest. Everywhere they are wisest. They are the magi.
excerpt.zh: 在所有送礼物和收礼物的人当中，像他们这样的人是最聪明的。无论在哪里，他们都是最聪明的。他们就是东方三博士。
